name: progressive-carousel

frames.best_why: A full photo slide with its caption and the progress bar row are both visible and cleanly framed.

tagline: Full-width photo carousel that auto-advances with thin progress bars.
summary: An auto-playing image carousel: one large 16:9 slide with a caption fades to the next every few seconds, while four thin bars below fill to show progress and double as slide buttons.
appearance: A large rounded photo slide fills the top with a dark gradient at its base carrying a bold white title and a smaller subtitle. Beneath it runs a row of four thin, evenly spaced progress bars, the active one brighter than the rest.
behaviour: The slide auto-advances every few seconds: the current photo fades out and the next fades in while the active bar fills from left to right. Clicking a bar fast-forwards to that slide.
demo_content: Slides 'Mountain Vista', 'Forest Path' and 'Desert Dunes' with nature subtitles.
use_when: A hero or gallery should cycle through a handful of images without visible arrows.
avoid_when: Auto-advance cannot be paused and there is no reduced-motion handling, so some users lose control.
customise: Duration, initial slide and vertical mode are props on ProgressSlider; slide order and count come from the children you pass, while bar colours are className edits.
weight_why: A requestAnimationFrame loop updates progress every frame plus a fade animation per slide.

a11y.note: The four bar buttons have no accessible names, the carousel auto-advances with no pause, and it ignores prefers-reduced-motion.

issues: Frames 2 and 5 show a near-black slide while the next image loads, so the crossfade flashes empty.
The carousel auto-advances with no pause control.
The progress bar buttons have no accessible names.
polish_why: Clean photo carousel and tidy progress bars; empty transition frames and no pause control are flaws.
